Gets reference holes from YAML (in the order they appear in the file)
For each YAML hole (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.):
Calculates distance and angle from PCB center
Finds the closest unmatched detected screw
Matches based on distance + angle similarity
Returns screws in YAML order - ensuring drilling follows the reference
Detection closest to Hole 1 position → Sent as 1st coordinate
Detection closest to Hole 2 position → Sent as 2nd coordinate
